front.tagline: A novel of rivers, ledgers and waiting

back.headline: Every crossing has a price.
back.blurb:
When the last ferry of the season fails to arrive, a customs clerk, a schoolteacher and a ferryman's daughter are left on the wrong bank of the river with a ledger that does not add up.

Over one long dry season they learn what the delta keeps and what it gives back. *The Salt Road* is placeholder text, written by a machine from lists of words, and set here to show what a finished book looks like.

It has nineteen chapters, forty footnotes, three pictures and an index, which is exactly what a typesetting test needs.
